message: So there I was, cozying up on the couch with my favorite blanket when the lights flickered and then—boom!—total blackout. I couldn't help but smile a bit because just last week, I’d insisted on charging all our power banks and dusting off the lanterns. While my family grumbled about the lack of power, I felt a smug 'I told you so' moment as I flipped on our trusty lantern and we gathered for a game by its warm glow. Who knew a little bit of prep could turn an inconvenience into a fun family night? What’s your favorite tip for making the most of a blackout? 🌟
